camel_example: aliyun pvtz AddZoneRecord --region cn-hangzhou --Rr www --Type A --ZoneId df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --Value '114.55.XX.XX'
description_en: Call the AddZoneRecord operation to add a DNS record to an authoritative zone. Within the effective scope of the zone, the internal DNS record for a domain name overwrites its public DNS record
description_zh: 调用AddZoneRecord添加内置权威解析记录。在解析生效范围内，该域名的内网解析记录会覆盖其公网解析记录
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz add-zone-record --zone-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --rr www --type A --value 114.55.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddZoneRecord

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone. This is the unique identifier of the zone
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The host record. A host record is the prefix of a domain name. Common host records include www, @, * (for wildcard DNS), and mail (for mailboxes).

For example, to resolve @.example.com, set the host record to "@", not an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
主机记录。主机记录就是域名前缀，常见用法有www、@、*（泛解析）、mail（常用于邮箱）。

例如要解析@.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写"@”，而不是空
parameters.name: rr

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DNS record. The following types are supported:

A: Maps a domain name to an IPv4 address in dotted decimal notation.

AAAA: Maps a domain name to an IPv6 address.

CNAME: Maps a domain name to another domain name.

TXT: A text record. The text can be up to 255 characters in length. TXT records are often used for Sender Policy Framework (SPF) records to prevent spam.

MX: Maps a domain name to the domain name of a mail server.

PTR: Maps an IP address to a domain name.

SRV: Specifies the server for a specific service. The format is: Priority Weight Port Target. Separate each value with a space.

Before adding a PTR record, configure a reverse lookup zone. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592976.html
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录类型，目前支持如下：
A：将域名指向一个IPV4（点分十进制格式的IPv4地址）。
AAAA：将域名指向一个IPV6（IPv6地址）。
CNAME：将域名指向另一个域名（域名地址）。
TXT：文本长度限制255，通常做SPF记录（反垃圾邮件）。
MX：将域名指向邮件服务器地址（邮件服务器的域名）。
PTR：将IP地址指向一个域名。
SRV：记录提供特定的服务的服务器（格式为 优先级 权重 端口 目标地址，每项中间需以空格分隔）。
添加PTR记录前需要先配置反解Zone，具体操作请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592976.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the DNS resolution request. Valid values:

default: The default line. This is equivalent to a global line. Configure a default line to ensure that a DNS record is returned even if no smart line is hit.

Alibaba Cloud line: The DNS resolution request comes from Alibaba Cloud, including Public Cloud, Alibaba Finance Cloud, and Alibaba Gov Cloud.

Custom line: Customize internal domain name resolution to return a specific IP address for DNS query requests from a specific IP address segment.

Only zones in built-in authoritative acceleration regions support adding DNS resolution request source lines.

To use the default line, enter "default". For Alibaba Cloud lines and custom lines, enter the specified line code. Example: aliyun_r_cn-beijing-a
parameters.help_zh:
解析请求来源。取值：

default：默认解析线路（相当于全局线路，建议您配置默认线路用于兜底，保障没有智能线路命中的情况下可以返回解析记录）。
阿里云线路（指解析请求来自阿里云，包括公共云、金融云、政务云）。
自定义线路（可以定制内网域名解析针对来源于某个特殊IP段的DNS查询请求返回特定的IP地址）

内置权威加速区域名才支持添加的解析请求来源线路。
选择默认解析，输入“default”即可，阿里云线路和自定义线路需填写指定线路编码。
例：aliyun_r_cn-beijing-a
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en: The weight. Valid values are integers from 1 to 100. The default value is 1. Set different weights for each address to return addresses based on the weight ratio for DNS queries
parameters.help_zh: 权重值（1-100 内的整数，包括 1 和 100，默认为1），支持对每个地址设置不同的权重值，实现解析查询按照权重比例返回地址
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The time to live (TTL). The unit is seconds (s). Valid values are 5, 30, 60, 3600 (1 hour), 43200 (12 hours), and 86400 (1 day). The default value is 60
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en: The priority of the MX record. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: [1, 99]
parameters.help_zh: MX记录的优先级。取值越小，优先级越高，取值范围：[1,99]
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The record value. Enter a value based on the DNS record type
parameters.help_zh: 记录值。根据不同解析记录类型，填写相应的记录值
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client generates this value to ensure that it is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

RecordId.description_en: The ID of the DNS record

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
